name: Lowari Tunnel
facts: Lowari Tunnel, stretching 10.4 km, opened in 2017 after a 42‑year construction saga that began in 1975, finally slashing the 14‑hour Chitral‑Peshawar drive to just seven hours.
At 10.4 km, Lowari Tunnel eclipsed Pakistan’s 3.91 km Khojak Tunnel in 2018, becoming the country’s longest vehicular tunnel and one of South Asia’s longest.
The tunnel’s all‑weather passage eliminated the seasonal Lowari Pass closure, ending Chitral travelers’ detour through Afghanistan’s Kunar province during harsh winters.
